localeDialog.deviceDiffers: Your device is set to a different time zone. Times here are not converted to it.

home.title: My calendars
home.none: You have not been given a calendar yet. Please ask your administrator.

needLink.title: Please open your personal link
needLink.body: To book, open the personal link you received from the staff. If you lost it, please ask the staff for a new one.

linkInvalid.title: This link does not work
linkInvalid.body: This link no longer works, or this calendar has closed. Please ask the staff for a new link.

home.noSlots: There are no available times at the moment.
home.noSlotsFull: There are no free times left to book. Please try again later.
home.noSlotsCustomerLimit: You have reached the maximum number of appointments you can hold. To change an appointment, please cancel one of your existing appointments.
home.noSlotsPeriodLimit: You have reached your daily or weekly booking limit for all the dates currently open for booking. Please try again once later dates open, or cancel one of your existing appointments.
home.paused: Booking is paused at the moment. You can still see and cancel your appointments.
home.title: Bookings

confirm.title: Please check your booking
confirm.invalid: This time could not be read. Please choose a time again.

done.title: Your booking is confirmed
done.arrival: Please arrive a few minutes before your time. If you cannot come, please cancel on the start page.

cancel.title: Do you really want to cancel this appointment?
cancel.tooLate: It is too late to cancel online. Please contact the staff.
cancel.doneBody: You can book a new time below.

register.title: Register
register.intro: Please enter your name. The staff will check your registration and then give you your personal booking link.
register.name: Your name

contact.text: How the staff can recognise you

contactHint.phone: So the staff can recognise you.
contactHint.email: So the staff can recognise you. We do not send emails.
contactHint.text: For example, your address or membership number.

register.paused: Registration is closed at the moment. Please ask the staff.

done.title: Thank you, your registration was received.
done.body: The staff will check it soon.
done.next: After approval, the staff will give you your personal booking link.

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.pausedBody: Customers cannot register or book. Activate it in the settings when you are ready.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.noApprovedCustomers: There are no approved customers yet.
appointments.noShowTitle: Mark this appointment as did not come?
appointments.timeHint: Times are in {{tz}}. Enter any future interval that does not overlap an appointment. Booking rules and pauses do not restrict staff.
appointments.recommendationsHint: These suggestions follow customer timing and quota rules. Choose one to fill the fields, then edit either time if needed.
appointments.noRecommendations: No recommended times. You can still enter a start and end time.

customers.title: Customers
customers.noteHint: Only staff can see this note. Customers never see it.
customers.linkOnce: Give this link to the customer now. For security it is shown only once; if it gets lost, create a new one.

confirm.disable: Disable {{name}}? Their link stops working immediately. Existing appointments stay.
confirm.regenerate_link: Create a new link for {{name}}? The old link stops working immediately.

schedule.title: Working hours
schedule.cycleIntro: The schedule repeats every N days. For a normal week use 7 days starting on a Monday. Lunch breaks are simply the gap between two periods.
schedule.midnightHint: An end time of 00:00 means midnight. Work past midnight is entered on the next day.
schedule.overridesIntro: A special date replaces the repeating schedule for that day, for example a holiday or different hours.
schedule.removeOverrideHint: The day will follow the repeating schedule again.
schedule.blocksIntro: Block a time range, for example a meeting. Blocks can span several days. Times are in {{tz}}.

problem.format: Fill in every start and end time.
problem.order: Each end time must be later than its start time.

schedule.overLimit: This schedule repeats every {{n}} days, more than the {{max}} days now allowed. It keeps working, but it must be shortened before it can be saved.
schedule.copyHint: This replaces the hours or day-off setting for the selected days. Save the schedule to make the changes take effect.
schedule.copyDone: Selected days updated. Save the schedule to keep these changes.
schedule.editHint: Select a day to edit its hours. Changes are kept when you switch days; save the schedule when you are finished.

policy.title: Booking rules
policy.intro: These rules apply to customer self-service bookings. Staff can set their own times. Changes do not move or cancel existing appointments.

hints.service_duration_minutes: The whole appointment must fit inside one working period.
hints.slot_step_minutes: Start times are counted from midnight, e.g. 15 gives :00, :15, :30, :45.
hints.buffer_minutes: The break may fall into lunch breaks or after closing time.
hints.booking_horizon_days: 0 means only today; 30 means up to 30 days from today.
hints.min_booking_notice_minutes: 0 allows booking right up to the start time.
hints.min_cancellation_notice_minutes: After this, customers must contact you to cancel.
hints.per_customer_daily_limit: Counts booked, completed and missed appointments; cancelled ones do not count.
hints.per_customer_weekly_limit: Weeks run from Monday to Sunday in the calendar's time zone.
hints.max_future_bookings: Appointments that have not started yet.

preview.title: Available times in the next two weeks
preview.collapsed: (a period is skipped because of the clock change)

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Appointment trends and current outcomes for this calendar.
statistics.rangeHint: Dates use {{timezone}}. Choose up to 366 days, including both dates.

grain.week: Weekly totals · weeks start on Monday

statistics.shareHint: Each status as a share of all selected appointments.
statistics.currentStatus: Counts reflect current records. Rescheduling or correcting a status updates past reports. Past appointments still marked booked are not counted as completed or no-shows.

basisHint.starts_at: Shows appointments scheduled to start in this period, including cancelled appointments. Customers are counted once across all statuses.
basisHint.created_at: Shows appointments created in this period and their current statuses, even when the service is scheduled outside this period. Customers are counted once across all statuses.

statistics.empty: No appointments in this period. Try another date range.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.createHint: The new operator is not bound to any calendar yet. Bind it on the “All calendars” page.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Give it to the person in person or by another safe way.
accounts.resetHint: Set a new password for {{name}}. They will be signed out everywhere.
accounts.disableHint: The operator is signed out and cannot sign in. Their calendars keep working for customers.
accounts.superAdminHint: The super admin changes its own details on “My account”.

instances.title: All calendars
instances.name: Name
instances.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. dr-tanaka. It appears in links.
instances.noOperators: No operators yet. Only the super admin can open this calendar.
instances.bindHint: Operators can open this calendar and do everything in it except delete it.
instances.noOperatorCandidates: Every enabled operator is already on this calendar. Create an operator account first.
instances.unbindHint: Remove {{name}} from {{instance}}? They can no longer open this calendar. Customers and appointments stay.
instances.createHint: The new calendar has no operators yet. Add them after creating it.
instances.copyHint: Copies the schedule, booking rules, time zone, language and page colour. Customers and appointments are never copied.
instances.deleteWarning: Everything in this calendar is deleted: customers, appointments, schedule and history. Customers’ links stop working. This cannot be undone.
instances.deleteConfirm: To confirm, type the calendar name: {{name}}

settings.title: System settings
settings.maxCycleDaysHint: Applies to every calendar. 1 to 366 days; the default is 30. Lowering it does not change schedules that are already saved.
settings.overLimitTitle: These calendars repeat over more days than allowed
settings.overLimitBody: They keep working. Their schedule must be shortened before it can be saved again.

settings.pausedHint: Customers cannot register or book new times. They can still see and cancel their appointments.
settings.pauseConfirm: Pause booking? Existing appointments stay as they are.
settings.inviteIntro: Customers scan this code to register. You can print it and download it again at any time.
settings.rotateConfirm: The old QR code and registration link will stop working. Customers' personal links are not affected.
settings.timezoneHint: All times are shown in this time zone.
settings.defaultLocaleHint: Used for customers who have not chosen a language.
settings.contactKind: What customers enter to be recognised
settings.tzConfirmBody_one: There is {{count}} upcoming appointment. It keeps its exact moment in time, but its local clock time will be shown differently.
settings.tzConfirmBody_other: There are {{count}} upcoming appointments. They keep their exact moment in time, but their local clock times will be shown differently.
settings.brandColorHint: Shown at the top of customer pages. Text colour is chosen automatically so it stays easy to read.
